reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.85% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +6bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (-0.1pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 12bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 140 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 89 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 15.8 sits at the 22th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 13.6, so implied carries +2.2 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: AI leveraged-loan investors push back for the first time in years: CoreWeave, Proofpoint among 4+ borrowers forced to sweeten terms in one week
items.note: Money managers overwhelmed by AI-debt supply are now demanding higher yields and stronger protections across multiple unrelated borrowers (CoreWeave's loan repriced to 5.5pts over benchmark; Proofpoint added roughly two dozen covenant changes at a ~9.3% yield) — a market-wide repricing of AI credit risk, not an isolated name.

items.headline: CoreWeave's credit-default swaps spike to 855bp, implying ~50% five-year default odds; Nebius/CoreWeave shares slide on the same read-through
items.note: A sharp, concrete widening in CDS pricing on a heavily-levered neocloud is a direct credit-market signal that financing costs for GPU-backed debt are becoming unsustainable, distinct from the equity move itself.

items.headline: BlackRock prices $12.5B bond for Meta's El Paso data center at 7.53% yield on weak ~$17B order book
items.note: One of the highest yields yet on a blue-chip data-center bond, with demand well below the multiple-times oversubscription that's typical for these deals — a concrete sign that data-center debt issuance is getting harder and costlier to clear.

items.headline: Moody's warns 'unprecedented' AI capex is eroding credit quality at Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and CoreWeave
items.note: Analyst warning rather than a rating action, but it's the clearest statement yet from a major rating agency that the shift from asset-light to capex-heavy AI buildouts is a credit-quality risk across hyperscalers and neoclouds alike.
